quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road may be wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street. You must follow the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move left.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that you are approaching a school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals tell other drivers your plans. When your left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down when approaching an intersection. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing your path.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Look for pedestrians and traffic crossing your path.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely. Then check for pedestrians and other traffic. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Stop completely. Then go only if it is safe.
Go carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Then go only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always stop completely. Only go forward when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign warns you that ahead is:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign means another road is coming into this one from the right.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic in the intersection go first.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely handle these curves.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot move out of your way, so you must wait for them to pass before you cross the tracks.

questions.question: What should you worry most about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Your vehicle might hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You might lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can make you lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital is to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it means the rider will turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings tell drivers about road hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid brake damage and accidents.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully in areas where pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: From top to bottom, traffic lights are arranged in this order:
questions.explanation: Vertical traffic lights always have red on top and green on bottom. Horizontal lights always have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Round signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: From bottom to top, traffic lights have these colors in order:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights go green, yellow, and red from bottom to top.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A group is cleaning up trash along the road ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated (35 mph in this example).

questions.question: This road sign indicates:

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for leaving a highway.
The safest speed for entering a highway.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for leaving a highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed for a highway exit. In this example, it is 30 mph.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road winds with many turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road winds with many turns.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of curves and turns.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The right lane is ending soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane is ending soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Only pennant-shaped signs are used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider's left arm is bent downward at the elbow, it means they are slowing down or stopping.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or for through traffic.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must obey it. Passing is not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you the road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This chevron sign shows that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, it curves to the left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet. You may lose control of your vehicle, so drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are near.
Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
Go through the intersection carefully without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on a crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must let vehicles and pedestrians in or crossing the intersection go first. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign warns that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your present speed.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the freeway. If no one is next to you, move over one lane.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is roadwork ahead. Detour to the right.
Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead turns sharply in the direction of the arrow. Slow down before the sharp turn, just as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It tells drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns that the divided highway will soon end.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: About conditions on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: About conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others go first if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others go first if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are important for communication when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. When you see it, slow down to check for traffic and let pedestrians and oncoming traffic go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction or road work. This sign tells you that road work is coming up. Slow down and be extra careful in work zones.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm with palm up, it means riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. You can turn left when it is safe.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is extended straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions without using turn signals. When your left arm is straight out to the left, it means you are turning left or changing lanes left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. Left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Slow down and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs show upcoming hazards. This sign warns you of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed and be prepared for curves.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph
You must drive through the intersection at this speed

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or other bad conditions, you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill
Trucks are on an upcoming hill

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop
Drive carefully and be ready to stop

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before moving forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit when weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. At this location, railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow. They warn of hazards ahead. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be entering from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
Lanes are for buses and cars with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can continue or exit from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane will leave the highway. You must either change lanes to continue, or stay in that lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out straight with palm down, then swings it down to their side, it means the group should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead shows red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead shows green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can use the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass or meet a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means you cannot do that action. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Prepare to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance from the vehicle ahead of you.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in a group communicate with each other. When the lead rider holds their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic on a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for yellow lights, red lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black symbols. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
You may go if the path is clear.
Come to a complete stop before going forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and could have a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Two lanes of traffic are merging.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (such as 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They prepare you for upcoming conditions. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming, so get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter the road or driveway from where you are. Turn around and go a different way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be present on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop and let other drivers go first at an intersection. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that low clearance is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop at a red light or slow down at a yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign tells you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.
